correctness.rationale: The globally complex-diffusive triangle has always stable synchrony (zero phase exponent; spatial mode quadratic with negative trace and positive determinant). Splay states with a=β−3p>0 have full real Jacobian polynomial λ(λ+2a){[λ²+(2a−3p)λ−3ap]²+9q²(λ+a)²}. Solving the only nonzero imaginary crossing yields a>3p and |q|²=p(2a−3p)²/[3(a−3p)]. Transversality changes stability at this threshold; minimizing F(β/p)=(2β/p−9)²/[3(β/p−6)]=8+4(β/p−15/2)²/[3(β/p−6)] gives sharp |q|/p>2√2 and the exact β window. Need ω,ω−3q both nonzero for genuine periodic orbits, otherwise attracting phase circles. Independently tested five full Jacobian spectra, plus source symbolic characteristic polynomial was inspected.
